title: slice-report.json
description: Output of `step-500 slice`: the producer's go/no-go on full production, after the .slice/ run of steps 200-500. Verdict PROCEED/PIVOT/KILL/NOT_ASSESSED after Claude-Code-Game-Studios vertical-slice-report.md. Missing evidence forces NOT_ASSESSED, never PASS.

verdict.description: PIVOT goes back to step-100; KILL archives; NOT_ASSESSED must be re-run after fixing inputs.

questions.description: Experience + feasibility pair; each answer cites evidence.

evidence.description: Path to the .slice/ artifact backing this answer.

missing.description: Required .slice/ artifacts that were absent; non-empty forces NOT_ASSESSED.

next.description: The command the verdict unlocks, e.g. 'step-200 run --scope all'.
